items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: We just had to read music. Oh, everybody read. Everybody read, because we were being taught by this fellow Kerry.

ctx.x: band, yeah. Yeah, but I thought you could fake then, too, huh? You could read and fake.
Well, no, that time, we didn't fake nothing at all. We just read. We didn't know. We just had to read music. Oh, everybody read. Everybody read, because we were being taught by this fellow Kerry.

Oh, I see. Let me ask you this. Did you ever have to transpose and change keys because some of the instruments were out of pitch? Oh, yeah, we had. Constantly doing that, huh? Sure, we had. So then you had to do it at full speed and transpose, too? That's right. I've often wondered about that because I know with the piano that we heard at Mrs. New Iberia, who was I speaking of a far ago? Chewy? No. Fontenay. Fontenay. Fontenay. Fontenay. Fontenay. That's over there. I just wondered because I knew they must have…
